Class GridView

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.canvas.Canvas
moldsim.view.GridView
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class GridView extends javafx.scene.canvas.Canvas
JavaFX Canvas-based grid renderer for the mold simulation.

Responsible for rendering the simulation grid, handling user input, and synchronizing visual state with the model.
